source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of visualization tools (PDF 148).

blocks.text: Data ko tasveeri shakal dena adad ko aasani se samajh aane wale charts aur graphs mein badalta hai. Bohat se tools yeh banate hain; sab se aasan mein Microsoft Excel aur Google Sheets hain, jo aam dastiyab hain aur charts aur graphs banana seedha karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Data visualization ke liye kaunsa tool aam istemal hota hai: MS Excel, Python (Matplotlib), Tableau, ya yeh sab (MCQ 4)?

items: Visualization tools: Excel aur Google Sheets (sab se aasan), aur Python Matplotlib aur Tableau bhi.
